# Guard the Open Internet

Mozilla is working to put control of the internet back in the hands of the people using it.

## Together, we can keep the internet easy, safe and free — for everyone.

## About Mozilla

The Mozilla Project is a global community of people who believe that openness, innovation, and opportunity are key to the continued health of the internet. We have worked together since 1998 to ensure that the internet is developed in a way that benefits everyone.

Today the organizations within the Mozilla Project include: the [Mozilla Foundation](https://www.mozillafoundation.org/), which champions our mission through philanthropic risk capital; [Mozilla Corporation](https://www.firefox.com/), which makes Firefox; [MZLA](https://thunderbird.net/), which makes Thunderbird; [Mozilla Ventures](https://mozilla.vc/), which invests in responsible tech startups; [Mozilla.ai](https://mozilla.ai/), which creates open source AI developer tools; [Mozilla Data Collective](https://mozilladatacollective.com/), a data sharing platform for human agency and fair value exchange.

[Mozilla.org](https://mozilla.org/) coordinates this whole family of organizations as well as community initiatives that support the Mozilla mission.

## Get to know Mozilla today

Mozilla is not only standing up for the open internet we originally helped to build, but also shaping what the internet is becoming in the AI era.

### 
      
        [Mozilla is rewiring itself for a new era. Our annual report, the State of Mozilla shares how.](https://stateof.mozilla.org/?utm_source=www.mozilla.org&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=about)
      
  

  
  Read the report

### 
      
        [A different AI future means being owners, not renters. Read our cross-portfolio open source AI strategy to learn more.](https://blog.mozilla.org/en/mozilla/mozilla-open-source-ai-strategy/?utm_source=www.mozilla.org&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=about)
      
  

  
  Read the strategy

## Work for Mozilla

We're hiring across the whole Mozilla family of organizations, and looking for people who want to push the boundaries of what's possible for the internet without compromising on what matters. You'll find deep shared values and some of the best benefits in the industry.

## Join our community

Mozilla is a global community of volunteers, fellows and contributors who have been building, protecting and shaping the internet with us since 1998. From writing code and spotting bugs to advocating for privacy and keeping the web open for everyone, here are some ways to get involved:

[Donate to Mozilla Foundation](https://www.mozillafoundation.org/en/?form=Mozilla-Website-Homepage&utm_source=www.mozilla.org&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=home) / [Download Firefox](https://www.firefox.com/en-US/) / [Contribute to Thunderbird](https://www.thunderbird.net/en-US/participate/) / [Share Your Skills](https://community.mozilla.org/en/)/ [Download + Upload Data](https://mozilladatacollective.com/) / [Explore New Open Source Tools](https://www.mozilla.ai/open-tools/docs) / [Share Your Deck](https://mozilla.vc/contacts/) / [Get Our Newsletter](https://newsletter.ownersnotrenters.com/)
